title: Disappointed!
text: Disappointed!. According to the directions, it's not supposed to be left in the freezer for more than 4 hours, and it has to be placed in there upside down - that part's doable, but I'm not happy about the time limitation.  Too much trouble to return but am not likely to use it often.

product_metadata.title: Liquid Logic Double Wall Gel Freezer Mug with Color Infused Handle, 16 oz, Orange
features: Color infused handle, base and lip
description: Make sure your favorite drink is frosty cold and stays that way with this 16-ounce double wall gel freezer mug. Stick in the freezer and make sure it gets cold and then pour your drink of choice! Features color infused handle, base and lip. Double wall and BPA-free. Hand wash only.
